Used 'uv pip freeze --python <venv_python>' as the equivalent measurement (Rule 3 blocking-issue fix) — same resolved-environment introspection uv itself used to perform the install.
config_dir_sha_note: sha256 over the sorted file tree (relative path + content, in sorted order) of $FIRESTARTER_CONFIG_DIR after seeding: files ['.gitkeep', 'config.json'].
config_dir_seed_method: No hardware-free CLI subcommand exists that persists a config value without a live serial device (firestarter config always issues COMMAND_CONFIG over serial, even with --rev -1; no board was attached in this container — confirmed absent via /dev/ttyACM*, /dev/ttyUSB* both absent). Seeded directly via the app's own public ConfigManager API from the control arm's venv: ConfigManager().set_value('_rig_seed_marker', '160-01-task3-bringup', persist=True). This dogfoods firestarter.config's public write path (the same _save_config() any real CLI invocation would call) without fabricating a hardware session.
